knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Shaking used linen spreads contamination into the air and onto clean surfaces, so the linen is gathered and bagged without shaking.
The stained item is isolated, marked and reported. Covering it with clean linen or washing it outside the approved procedure both conceal the defect or spread the problem.
Only products named on the approved inventory are used for amenities. Products from home and unlabelled refills are not approved.
The sorting section says to read the care label on each item before loading it.

practicalCriteria: Bags a simulated used linen set without shaking, after inspecting it for sharps and visible contamination, and escalates a simulated sharp or heavy contamination.
Launders a sample set by its care label and the approved setting, and reports a simulated machine fault without working around it.
Prepares a bed with clean hands, a checked protector and correctly fitted linen, kept clear of the floor.
Replenishes simulated amenities from the approved inventory, checking seal, expiry and cleanliness.
Isolates and reports a simulated stain and a stock shortfall, without covering or concealing either.
passRule: Used linen handled without shaking and escalated where required, bed prepared correctly, amenities from the approved inventory only, and defect and shortage reported without concealment. Observed in a supervised simulation. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Record of any simulated sharp or heavy contamination escalated
stopWorkCriteria: Used linen shaken or sharp removed by hand
Unapproved refill or personal product used
Machine loaded beyond its rated load or fault worked around
